title: Factory RFC-0001 completion event (v1.3, per-worker usage + live sub-events + progress heartbeats)
description: AIFactory completion events. v1.3 (#45 P1) additively (a) extends the terminal event's usage block with a per-worker breakdown (usage.workers[]) and by_provider{} / by_model{} rollups (scalar usage fields kept for back-compat), and (b) adds a LIVE per-worker sub-event with phase:"worker", status:"worker_done", and an additive top-level worker{} object emitted as each parallel/serial worker finishes. v1.3 Tier 2 (#45) additionally adds a LIVE per-worker PROGRESS heartbeat with phase:"worker_progress", status:"running", and a worker{} snapshot ({worker_id, subtask_id, agent_phase, provider, model, total_tokens, cost_usd, elapsed_ms}) emitted periodically (throttled) while a worker is still running. v1.2 (#466) added a per-event idempotency id, CloudEvents-core fields, and W3C trace context alongside the legacy RFC-0001 fields. additionalProperties is permitted so the envelope can keep growing additively without breaking validation; the worker object and the new usage fields are optional, so old producers/consumers still validate.

worker.description: Per-worker (per-subtask) record carried by a LIVE sub-event. Two flavours, distinguished by the event's phase/status/type: (1) the one-shot worker-DONE event (phase:"worker", status:"worker_done") emitted as a worker finishes (v1.3, #45 P1), carrying input/output/total tokens, cost_usd, and duration_ms; (2) the periodic PROGRESS heartbeat (phase:"worker_progress", status:"running", type io.factory.aifactory.worker_progress) emitted while a worker is still running (v1.3 Tier 2, #45), carrying the running snapshot total_tokens, cost_usd, and elapsed_ms. Both are additive and optional; absent on the terminal event and for old producers. Dedup/identity key for consumers: (service, correlation_key, worker.worker_id).

workers.description: Per-worker (per-subtask) usage breakdown (v1.3, #45 P1). Additive; absent for old producers. A serial single-model task carries one implicit 'main' worker.

billing_mode.description: Billing mode of this worker's provider (v1.3, #96). api/cloud are metered (real cost_usd); subscription/local are not (cost_usd is notional/zero - show tokens + time instead). Additive/optional.

by_provider.description: Token/cost rollup keyed by provider, derived from workers[] (v1.3, #45 P1). Additive.

billing_mode.description: Billing mode shared by this provider's workers (#96). Metered when api/cloud; subscription/local are not.

by_model.description: Token/cost rollup keyed by model, derived from workers[] (v1.3, #45 P1). Additive.

budget.description: Soft budget alert (v1.3, #45 P2). Present only when the contract set execution.budget_usd. OBSERVE-ONLY: a warning surface comparing the rolled-up spend against the budget; the build is NEVER aborted. Additive and optional; omitted when no budget is set.
